name: StickyCue CTA Button for WooCommerce
author: storeopswp

sections.description:
StickyCue CTA Button for WooCommerce adds a compact mobile sticky call-to-action button to WooCommerce single product pages.

The plugin is intentionally focused:

  • Mobile only.
  • Single product pages only.
  • No sticky price.
  • No product image.
  • No desktop or tablet sticky bar.
  • Native WooCommerce add-to-cart trigger for safe normal simple products.
  • Scroll-to-form behavior for products that require a selection or review before adding to cart.

StickyCue is designed to stay out of the way until the customer has scrolled past the real product purchase area. It then appears as a shortcut back to the purchase action.

Behavior

Normal safe simple products:

  • Default button text: Add to Cart
  • Click action: trigger the native WooCommerce product form / Add to Cart button
  • WooCommerce controls the result, including redirect and add-to-cart message behavior

PriceCue-enabled simple products:

  • Default button text: Shop Now
  • Click action: scroll to the PriceCue selector / purchase form

Variable, grouped, external, unavailable, or option-based products:

  • Default button text: Choose Options
  • Click action: scroll to the product purchase form

Settings

Go to WooCommerce > StickyCue CTA.

Available settings:

  • Enable StickyCue
  • Mobile breakpoint
  • PriceCue product button text
  • Simple product button text
  • Options product button text
  • Button background color
  • Button text color
  • Button border color
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stickycue-cta-button directory, or install the plugin ZIP through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > StickyCue CTA to review the settings.
  5. Test one mobile product page before enabling the behavior across a live store.
sections.faq:
Does StickyCue replace the normal WooCommerce Add to Cart button?

No. StickyCue adds a mobile shortcut. The normal product page purchase form remains the source of truth.

Does StickyCue show price in the sticky button?

No. StickyCue intentionally does not display price or product images in the sticky bar.

Does StickyCue add simple products to the cart directly?

For safe normal simple products, StickyCue triggers the native WooCommerce product form / Add to Cart button. WooCommerce then handles the add-to-cart flow, redirects, and messages.

What happens for variable products or products with options?

StickyCue scrolls to the product purchase form instead of bypassing required selections.

What happens for PriceCue-enabled products?

StickyCue scrolls to the PriceCue quantity selector / purchase form so the customer can select the intended quantity tier before adding to cart.

Does StickyCue appear on desktop or tablet?

No by default. StickyCue is mobile-only and appears at or below the configured mobile breakpoint.
sections.changelog:
1.0.7

  • Addressed Plugin Check production-readiness findings.
  • Removed the root TESTING.md file from the release package.
  • Removed the Domain Path header and manual text-domain loading for WordPress.org-hosted translations.
  • Updated Tested up to metadata to 7.1.
  • Updated Author URI to https://storeopswp.com/.
  • No frontend behavior changes from 1.0.6.

1.0.6

  • Prepared the plugin package for WordPress.org submission.
  • Added WordPress.org-friendly plugin metadata, dependency headers, licensing headers, installation notes, and FAQ content.
  • Added uninstall cleanup for StickyCue options.
  • No frontend behavior changes from 1.0.5.

1.0.5

  • Added backend color settings for the sticky CTA button background, text, and border.
  • Keeps the v1.0.4 premium filled-button default while allowing each store to match its brand/accent color.
  • No behavior changes.

1.0.4

  • Refined the mobile sticky CTA visual style to a centered, premium dark filled button.
  • Hardened StickyCue button CSS against theme button overrides.
  • Kept the same v1.0.3 native WooCommerce add-to-cart behavior and v1.0.2 visibility logic.

1.0.3

  • Changed normal simple product StickyCue clicks to trigger the native WooCommerce product form / Add to Cart button.
  • Removed the custom AJAX add-to-cart flow.
  • Removed the After direct add-to-cart setting. WooCommerce’s own redirect and message settings now control the result for normal simple products.

1.0.2

  • Refined mobile visibility logic so the sticky CTA appears only after the purchase area has scrolled above the viewport.
  • Prevents the sticky CTA from appearing when the customer scrolls back above the purchase area.

1.0.1

  • Improved mobile visibility timing so the sticky CTA appears only after the native purchase area has been seen at least once and is no longer visible.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
